title: Love this!
body: I love this app so much, it’s very simple and easy to use, no owerwhelming distractions either! I love how simple and cute it is, and I would love to witness Cub grow up! I would like if there were more different widgets, and also more storyline explorations. Maybe some lesson and reflection updates too? I love this so much and would recommend this to everyone!
